question: At the frozen independent-32 sampled state, does R27's all-cardinality antipodal-pair relation law still hold relative to that state's own full-five-coordinate membership?
hypothesis: Across all 32767 nonconstant complement-normalized binary partitions at independent-32, every one of the 32640 partitions that separates at least one antipodal pair will reproduce independent-32 full-five-coordinate membership in all four phase-plus-one-derived-coordinate panels, while all 127 partitions preserving every antipodal pair will match zero panels; no partition will be partial and every populated mask-cardinality stratum 1 through 15 will have zero law mismatches despite the further-halved observation budget.

prior_evidence.observation: At independent-64 all 32640 pair-splitting partitions matched all four panels, all 127 pair-preserving partitions matched zero panels, no partition was partial, and all cardinality strata had zero law mismatches while the full-five-coordinate state contained sixteen classes, three correct alias triplets, and six split triplets.

scope_statement: This changes exactly one R27 dimension: the frozen independent sampler record budget is reduced from 64 to 32 observations per surface. Partition enumeration, complement normalization, antipodal-pair relation, four projections, exact membership comparison against the same state's full-five-coordinate classes, capacity, induction, and evaluator-only audit remain fixed. It makes no population, task-learning, natural-language, or deployment claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.r27_replication_control: Run the unchanged local deterministic R27 probe and require its frozen exact law and cardinalities before R28 output.
arms_and_inputs.independent32_state: Use the frozen deterministic R6 independent sampler streams at exactly the first 32 observations for each of 27 surfaces, yielding exactly 864 records. Class count and alias-triplet structure are scientific outputs, not validity gates, except that classes must partition all 27 surfaces without cross-entity collision.
arms_and_inputs.partition_enumeration: Enumerate masks 1..65535 ascending; retain exactly masks with bit zero clear, yielding one representative of each nonconstant complement pair and exactly 32767 partitions.
arms_and_inputs.cardinality_strata: Stratify by mask popcount 1..15; require stratum k to contain exactly C(15,k) partitions and every stratum to be populated.
arms_and_inputs.pair_relation: For each q in 0..7 compare bit(q) with bit(q+8). A partition is pair_preserving only when all eight agree and pair_splitting otherwise.
arms_and_inputs.combinatorial_cardinalities: Require exactly 127 pair-preserving and 32640 pair-splitting partitions; independently construct the 127 nonempty unions of antipodal pairs 1..7 and require exact set equality.
arms_and_inputs.partition_panel: For every retained mask evaluate [bucket,prefix0], [bucket,prefix1], [bucket,suffix0], and [bucket,suffix1] against independent-32 full-five-coordinate membership, exactly 131068 arms in mask then coordinate order.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Exact projected-support equality, pair-relation and cardinality-stratum cardinalities, class-membership comparison, and evaluator-only entity audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.independent32_arm: Frozen deterministic independent sampler streams inherited unchanged from R6 and R27; exactly the first 32 observations per surface.
seeds.r27_control: Exact frozen R27 independent-64 construction and inherited controls.

controls: The unchanged local deterministic R27 probe must reproduce underobserved_unbalanced_antipodal_law_exact, 32640 pair-splitting all-four matches, 127 pair-preserving zero matches, no partial match, zero classification mismatches, and zero stratum law mismatches before R28 output.

The independent-32 state must contain exactly 864 records and 32 records per surface; its full-five-coordinate classes must partition all 27 surfaces into 9..27 classes, report 0..9 correct and 0..9 split alias triplets, and retain zero cross-entity collision pairs.
Enumeration must yield exactly 32767 distinct nonconstant bit-zero-clear masks, with stratum k equal to C(15,k), partitioned exclusively into 32640 pair-splitting and 127 pair-preserving masks.
An independent enumeration of nonempty subsets of antipodal pairs 1..7 must yield exactly the same 127 pair-preserving masks.
All 131068 arms run once in ascending mask then derived-coordinate order; entity and family labels are unavailable to projection and induction and enter only the post-induction audit.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R27 probe reproduces its frozen classification and exact cardinalities before R28 output.
The independent-32 sampled state exactly reproduces frozen record counts and satisfies the preregistered structural class-partition ranges without cross-entity collision.
Partition classes and cardinality strata are exhaustive, mutually exclusive, formula-checked, and have frozen cardinalities; the pair-preserving set equals the independent construction.
Every arm has frozen cardinality, valid byte ranges, finite metrics, and exactly 36 unordered entity pairs audited.
Full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, seed search, adaptive arm selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.sparse_unbalanced_antipodal_law_exact: Validity and controls pass; all 32640 pair-splitting partitions match all four panels, all 127 pair-preserving partitions match zero panels, no partition is partial, classification mismatch count is zero, and every cardinality stratum has zero law mismatches.
classification_rules.sparse_breaks_pair_splitting_sufficiency: Validity and controls pass; at least one pair-splitting partition fails one or more panels.
classification_rules.sparse_breaks_pair_preserving_failure: Validity and controls pass; at least one pair-preserving partition matches one or more panels.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass but none of the preceding scientific rules applies.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Any frozen R27, independent-32 state, full-five-coordinate partition, enumeration, cardinality-stratum, normalization, uniqueness, or independent-set control fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the complete fixed 131068-arm panel.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, class-exclusivity, arm-cardinality, projection, sample-count, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.
